app.name: Budget Tracker
app.demoBanner: Public demo · fictional data · resets nightly

login.title: Sign in to the demo
login.subtitle: Pick a role to explore. No password needed.
login.asExecutiveHint: Sees all 8 teams, approves unbudgeted spend.
login.asChampionHint: Owns one team's budget and its line items.
login.asFinanceHint: Second approval on spend above the threshold.

dashboard.title: Site overview

heat.title: Monthly spend vs plan
heat.subtitle: Percent of each month’s plan booked. Select a cell to open that team’s month.
heat.callout: {team}, {month}: {description}, {amount}.{status, select, over { It’s why the team is already over budget.} other {}}

monthly.title: Planned vs committed vs actual
monthly.subtitle: {scope, select, team {Team total} other {Site total}} by month, {currency}

approvals.title: Needs your decision
approvals.exposure: {amount} pending · not yet in the forecast
approvals.failed: Couldn’t record the decision. Refresh and try again.
approvals.impact: Approving {count, plural, one {it} other {all #}} adds {amount} to the forecast: {total} {direction, select, over {over} other {under}}.

dashboard.summary: Projected to finish {amount} {direction, select, over {over} other {under}} budget ({pct}).
dashboard.review: Review {count, plural, one {# request} other {# requests}}

forecast.title: Where the year lands
forecast.subtitle: Cumulative spend, {scope, select, team {team total} other {site total}}, {currency}
forecast.endDelta: {direction, select, over {▲ {amount} over budget} other {▼ {amount} under budget}}
forecast.rule: Closed months count what was booked; open months assume max(plan, booked), per line item.
forecast.summary: {booked} booked through {month}; projected to finish at {projected} against a {budget} budget.

lands.title: Where each team lands
lands.subtitle: Projected year-end as % of each team’s budget. Biggest overrun first.

team.title: Team budget
team.noDriver: Every line item is within plan.

savings.title: Savings
savings.headline: {amount} saved so far
savings.explain: Unspent plan in closed months, netted per line item.

lands.title: Where each line item lands
lands.subtitle: Projected year-end as % of each line item’s plan. Biggest overrun first.

team.heatSubtitle: Percent of each month’s plan booked, by line item. Select a cell to see that month’s expenses.

comingSoon: This screen is coming in phase {phase}.

expenses.title: Expenses
expenses.subtitle: Every planned purchase and invoice, in its original currency.
expenses.readOnly: Expenses are entered by team champions and delegates. You can review everything here.
expenses.summary: {count, plural, =0 {No expenses match} one {# expense} other {# expenses}} · {total} total

form.rateLocked: Rate locked when the expense was entered.
form.nextFyHint: Commitment for FY2027: kept out of this year’s forecast.
form.invoiceDisabled: Uploads are disabled in the public demo.
form.reasonHint: Why is this needed now? Approvers see this.
form.remaining: {amount} left on this line item this year.
form.willNeedApproval: This will start an approval request: {why}
form.whyOver: it exceeds the line item’s remaining plan.
form.locked: In the approval flow: only the status can change.
form.lockedClosed: This expense is in a closed month and can’t be edited.

toast.forbidden: You can only edit your own team’s expenses.
toast.locked: This expense can’t be edited anymore.
toast.failed: Couldn’t save. Check the form and try again.
toast.closed: That month is closed: its expenses can’t be added to or edited.

errors.amount: Enter an amount greater than 0 with up to 2 decimals.

approvals.title: Approvals
approvals.subtitle: Unbudgeted and over-plan expenses go through Champion → Executive → Finance (above {threshold}).

detail.title: Approval request

impact.title: Impact if approved
impact.explain: Pending requests aren’t in the forecast yet. Approving this one moves the team’s projection:

detail.commentHint: Shown in the timeline. Recommended when rejecting.

close.title: Month close
close.subtitle: Finance’s ledger is reconciled against the tracker every night. Each exception needs a person to explain it; nothing is corrected automatically. A month closes once every exception is explained, and closing locks its expenses.
close.totalsNote: Ledger: everything finance posted that loaded. Tracker: actual and accrued spend finance should have posted. Rejected ledger rows aren’t in either total.
close.confirm: Close {month}? Its expenses will be locked.
close.newSinceClose: {count, plural, one {# exception arrived after it closed.} other {# exceptions arrived after it closed.}}
close.readOnly: Only finance resolves exceptions and closes months.

blocker.current: {month} is still the current month; it can be closed once it ends.
blocker.noLedger: The ledger for {month} hasn’t been loaded yet.
blocker.unresolved: {count, plural, one {# exception still needs an explanation before {month} can close.} other {# exceptions still need an explanation before {month} can close.}}
blocker.previousOpen: Months close in order: close the month before {month} first.
blocker.forbidden: Only finance can close a month.
blocker.failed: Couldn’t close {month}. Refresh and try again.

close.exceptionsTitle: {count, plural, =0 {No exceptions} one {# exception} other {# exceptions}}
close.noExceptions: Every ledger posting matched the tracker this month.
close.noLedger: No ledger postings for this month yet.

hint.amount_mismatch: Both sides have it, for different amounts.
hint.ledger_only: Finance posted it; the tracker has no expense for it.
hint.tracker_only: The tracker has it as spent; finance hasn’t posted it.

close.resolutionHint: At least 10 characters: what you checked, and what happens next.
close.awaiting: Waiting for finance to explain it.

toast.invalid: Write a short explanation (at least 10 characters).
toast.gone: Someone already explained this one. Refresh to see it.
toast.failed: Couldn’t save. Refresh and try again.

close.rejectsTitle: {count, plural, one {# rejected ledger row} other {# rejected ledger rows}}
close.rejectsHint: These rows failed validation and weren’t loaded. They’re fixed in the ledger and re-sent, not explained here.
